fee_assumption.source: Binance spot taker fee, set explicitly in the config
fee_assumption.slippage_note: no slippage model; market orders priced on the far side of the book

metrics.turnover_note: entry notional plus exit notional, approximated as 2x total stake
metrics.fees_note: derived as 2 x fee(0.001) x total stake; the engine reported no per-trade fee fields
metrics.passive_realised_exposure_matched_note: 50/50 passive return scaled to the strategy's realised average capital exposure; an approximation that ignores when that exposure occurred
metrics.provenance_note: Engine figures come from Freqtrade's own backtest export; exposure, turnover, fee and realised-exposure-matched figures are computed by research/summarize_backtest.py from the exported trade list.

reason: VALIDATION_PROTOCOL_RESULT = PASS, VALIDATION_PERFORMANCE_CLASSIFICATION = NEUTRAL. The unchanged baseline was run exactly once on the pre-declared Validation window after its logic and the Development protocol were frozen. It returned -0.07% over 607 days in a market that fell 21.70%, against a realised-exposure-matched passive line of -2.03%, so E = +1.97 percentage points - inside the NEUTRAL band. Profit factor 0.997 is above the 0.8 WEAK threshold and the sample of 96 closed trades is above the 30-trade minimum, so the classification is NEUTRAL on its merits rather than for lack of data.
